About Compath OÜ

Compath OÜ is an Estonian company. We keep computers, networks and everyday web tools working, and we build WordPress plugins and AI agents for a process you can describe. The work can be done remotely.

Who we are

Compath OÜ — Tallinn, Estonia. Registry code 11502963, VAT EE101244231. Address: Ahtri 12, Tallinn 10151, Estonia.

What we do

Three kinds of work:

  1. IT support and maintenance — networks, computers and office equipment, domains, hosting, e-mail, websites, VoIP, and ongoing maintenance. For companies and homes.
  2. Plugins and AI agents — WordPress plugins for a workflow of your own, and AI agents with workflow automation such as n8n integrations.
  3. Amazon launch consulting — account setup, listings, and the basics of advertising (PPC). We advise; you remain the seller.

We also publish our own WordPress plugin, Choir Rehearsal: a private rehearsal library for choirs (songs, per-voice tracks, PDF scores, optional YouTube embeds). Lite is free on WordPress.org. Pro is €49 a year from shop.compath.ee. Product site: rehearsal.compath.ee.

Who it is for

  • Companies and homes that need IT kept running — remotely when that fits.
  • Teams that want a WordPress plugin or an AI/n8n workflow described in plain language.
  • Sellers preparing a first launch on Amazon.
  • Choirs that need a private rehearsal library on their own WordPress site.
